description: The Ocean Color and Temperature Scanner (OCTS) is a twelve-band optical radiometer measuring ocean colour and sea-surface temperature. Its visible and near-infrared channels probe phytoplankton and dissolved material in ocean water.
short_description: ADEOS Ocean Color and Temperature Scanner (OCTS) visible/NIR bands
facility_description: ADEOS was a Japanese Earth-observation satellite carrying OCTS.
notes: NJM contains eight visible/near-infrared bands, not all twelve OCTS channels.
